observations.fact: RunJournal exposes allocate, transact, append and reserveResumeAttempt. EndstopLedger exposes execute and executeChild. V1 ReserveAction already carries reservationId; evaluate is available only in V2 ReleaseActionV1.
observations.required_correction: Specify stable reservationId reuse and require existing V2 evaluation authority for natural-language predicates, or reject unsupported V1 admission.

observations.fact: StoredEvent freezes the envelope but leaves type and payload opaque. Event bounds are 1 MiB physical line, nesting 64, 100000 JSON nodes, and 64 MiB total replay input. Pel permits deeper or larger values.
observations.required_correction: Use hash-bound immutable artifact references for deep or large continuation/result/argument/output values; flush before the journal reference and verify on resume.

observations.fact: Orchestration already references core, event-log, policy and session-store. Its composite tsconfig rootDir is src and excludes src/**/*.test.ts. Adding a providers project reference requires providers to avoid importing orchestration.
observations.required_correction: Use a providers-owned injected credential port and separate non-test fixture entry with explicit build ownership.
